notes.title: Version 1.1 Update! - New Features
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/cc02c45a253128af7216537d2add5e1afec4e927.png[/img]

[b]We have some new features and more![/b]

We're back with a few new features for you to enjoy!  We took some time while we were porting the game to Switch to check a few more boxes off the list of things we would like to have in the game, things like ...

[h1][b]Colorblind Support![/b][/h1]
[list][*]In the options menu, players can now enable a colorblind mode. This setting will adapt the colors of the tiles a bit, while adding patterns to the tiles to help differentiate players. There are 3 contrast levels for the patterns.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/4f6ec24e4191d9607a2f48c848825c11870491b5.png[/img]

[h1][b]End of Match Stats[/b][/h1]
[list][*]When completing a match, you'll now see a stats window in the corner of the victory screen displaying Wins, Kills, Crushes and Dash Captures. All of these are cumulative across all of the matches you've played since selecting characters, and [b]will reset if players return to player select.[/b] 
Don’t forget, you can change maps and match settings through the level select to keep consistent stats![/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/70ca9265ef0b0bcabd109d1f21ab5a5785f0ae4a.png[/img]

We also touched up the game in a few cool areas! 

[h1][b]Optimization Overhaul[/b][/h1]
[list][*]The game's performance has been optimized heavily in preparation for the game's launch on Nintendo Switch! This should result in the game running smoother, especially on lower end systems.[/list]

[h1][b]Smarter, More Stable AI![/b][/h1]
[list][*]Several AI bugs have been fixed which should make them a slightly smarter, more natural opponent.[/list]

[h1][b]Bug and Crash Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Lots of miscellaneous bugs have been ironed out, and several potential crashes have been patched.[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new features, and don't forget, we're coming to the Nintendo Switch this November!

notes.title: Battery Jam - 1.0 Launch!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/70b6b91703bac9637fb8c111edd93831ffca287f.png[/img]

[b]It's here! Battery Jam 1.0![/b] 

We set a goal years ago to release a game, we were lucky enough to get to develop it full time for the last 9 months or so, and here we are. After all our planning, discussions, and hard work getting Battery Jam to what we felt made for a solid and complete experience we're finally here! 

With that content completion comes a price change. We'd intended to adjust the price at launch since we went live into Early Access, and that's happening as promised. Today, we're bumping it up to $14.99. We wouldn't do it if we didn't think it was worth it, and we hope you agree! If you don't, then make sure you keep an eye on Steam Sales! 

But enough about money, how about what's being added to this update?

[h1][b]Two More Levels![/b][/h1]
[list][*]Nebula and Satellite both focus on narrow arena formations to emphasize the ability to control zones of the board with raised tiles. On top of that, they're in outer space, so everything else is irrelevant![/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/0d6e7639603725913622a20a6746b6605aa77a96.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/1b6749294b0bd8342be6418997b7460333bc0dce.png[/img]

[h1][b]Language Support![/b][/h1]
[list][*]One out of three Halseo employees have studied Japanese a bit. So we went to people who knew what they're doing for this one![/list]  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/5355196e7f244fe8b3802cc860dcefc90f1ffe12.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Bot Difficulty![/b][/h1]
[list][*]We hope the AI difficulty settings allow players to fine tune their experience a bit more! Dig in and crush them at every difficulty![/list]  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/0a35c432668a6f93f9eb1dda795bf4254780eda8.png[/img]

[h1][b]Various Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Addressed boomboxes merging
[*]Added mouse symbols in options and in game while using Mouse and Keyboard
[*]Options menu glitch for keyboard support
[*]Visual glitch on skyline
[*]Boomboxes spawning out of the arena
[*]Addressing AI loitering
[*]Numerous small fixes[/list]  

[b]We hope you enjoy the game, and on behalf of the three of us at Halseo, thank you to the players, and to our friends and family that helped along the way, and SCAD+, for making this possible![/b]

notes.title: Full Release coming May 17th!
notes.content:
Great news everyone! 

[h1][b]We're one week away from releasing our 1.0 version on May 17th![/b][/h1]

What does that mean? 
[list]
[*][h1][b]Two more levels being added![/b][/h1]
Here's a peek at one of them!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/0d6e7639603725913622a20a6746b6605aa77a96.png[/img]

[*][h1][b]We have AI difficulty settings coming in![/b] [/h1]

[*][h1][b]And of course, some general bug fixing![/b][/h1]
[/list]

[h1][b]In slightly less positive news...[/b][/h1]
Right now, there is a small hiccup on our side. We had intended to raise the price of the game to $14.99 once we came out of Early Access. You might have noticed, as of this writing on May 10th, 2018 at about 10 AM Eastern, the price has already changed. 

We were under the impression we would choose when that new pricing would go into effect, and seems we misunderstood! We're really sorry about that. We've reached out to Steam for some help and are working to see if we can kick the price back down for the rest of Early Access. 

Keep an eye on our [url=https://twitter.com/batteryjamgame] Twitter [/url] for updates about that situation, we'll inform everyone as soon as we have answers!

notes.title: Battery Jam Update 0.7 : Levels and AI Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/6a2a3ccc01563489ff02178a9ee5e8e0e5477e7a.png[/img]
[h1][b]SMALL LIST FOR A BIG CONTENT UPDATE![/b][/h1]

Hope you're ready for our coolest update yet! Not only are we adding two new levels, which happen to be our fanciest levels to date, Plant and Slag, but we're adding AI so you can beat them up IN THE NEW LEVELS! 

You can add them to a match while you're in character select! Check it out! 

[h1]Here's the list of awesome stuff we packed into this update![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/5e51660b11f52683ac1427856c18ca2dab32c70d.gif[/img]
[list]
    [*][h1][b]Plant[/b][/h1] - A dense, small new level set in a beautiful and serene jungle! Or is it? Plant is a real tight level where you're always vulnerable!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/c3527f6246783c0827659b80fc7fb4a68af34a47.jpg[/img]
    [*][h1][b]Slag[/b][/h1] - This laboratory isn't just eerie, it's also huge and empty! Make the most of the space to attack poorly defended opponents from across the map!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/0d98a7ceb3ffe37d537ebf4b03d5a3a89df3f510.jpg[/img]
    [*][h1][b]AI Opponents[/b][/h1] - Now you can play the game solo or use AI to fill out matches with friends! They can be added in the character selection screen!
[/list]
    [*][h1][b]Mouse and Keyboard Support[/b][/h1] - Now that single player is possible in Battery Jam, it only made sense to properly support keyboard and mouse control! Mouse input is supported across all the menus and the keyboard and mouse control in game has been greatly improved and refined.
[/list]

notes.title: Battery Jam Update 0.6 : The Customization Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/a2eba50b1d79ba9f2460f85892b1606bbe445872.png[/img]

[h1][b]IT’S TIME FOR AN UPDATE![/b][/h1]

You want match settings? Teleporters? Enhanced visual elements on levels? Refined music tracks!? [i]YOU GOT 'EM![/i]

[h1]Here's the short list:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added Match Settings menu
[*]Added optional teleporters to every map
[*]Added level specific feedback once game timer reaches 30 seconds
[*]Updated various music tracks with additional saxophone 
[*]Updated Tutorial and Control Screen for clarification
[*]Good old fashioned bug fixes
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458831/1fc7df1b6018c33d1a48d1635f8c1d6110ca4039.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Match Settings[/b][/h1]
We’ve added a ton of options and ways to modify the game! Great features like...

[b]Game Mode Presets[/b]
[list]
[*]We’ve added pre-built game mode options for easy access, which you can further customize with tons of settings, such as...
[/list]
[b]Game Speed[/b]
[list]
[*]Now you can tailor the pace of the game to your preference! Choose between normal, slow or fast game speed!
[/list]
[b]Teleporters[/b]
[list]
[*]Push boomboxes into the teleporter to catch the competition off guard, or run through yourself to traverse the map quickly! 
[/list]
[b]Invisible Territory[/b]
[list]
[*]This modifier makes it so the colors of the tiles fade over time! Spice up our default mode by adding some mystery to who’s tiles you’re destroying, or add in deathmatch scoring to take the focus off the arena! 
[/list]
[b]Score Type[/b]
[list]
[*]You can also now change whether the score in a match is based off of tiles captured, kills, or crushes with the boombox! 
[/list]
[b]Timers[/b]
[list]
[*]Boombox timer, match length, respawn time each have an option in match settings to adjust! 
[/list]
[b]Boomboxes[/b]
[list]
[*]More than the timer option, you can also choose whether or not they turn into capture boxes, and how many boomboxes appear in the arena! Two not enough? Try ten!
[/list]
[b]Infinite Energy[/b]
[list]
[*]And not an ounce of responsibility!
[/list]
[b]Points to Win[/b]
[list]
[*]Two minute matches not your style? Change the game to a points to win setting to have standard deathmatch modes, or a variation on our default tile based mode! 
[/list]

[h1][b]Level Updates[/b][/h1]
Now on each level, when you’re playing a timer based game mode, each level will have a unique event to help ramp up the tension of those final moments!

[h1][b]Updated Tutorial and Control Screen[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed the “Rocket Punch” to “Stun Shot” to help clarify the intent of the ability. 
[*]Changed “Popping and Dropping Tiles” to “Raising and Lowering Tiles” for clarity.
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Problem with the bubble making player invincible after attempted pop while bubbled
[*]Problem with players remaining stretched when hit while dashing
[*]Problem with players getting knocked out of the play space
[*]Problem with victory screen displaying in slomo
[*]A bunch of other inconsequential bugs not worth mentioning!
[/list]

notes.title: Available now!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy launch day!![/h1]

Battery Jam has now been released into Early Access! 
So what does that mean!?

It means you get the game! Which as of launch on January 30th, contains all four characters, four levels, Classic Jam (Free for All)  and Team Jam!

Over the course of early access we'll be working to add features like - 
[list]
[*]New Levels
[*]New Music
[*]AI Bots
[*]Match Settings   
[/list]

We'll also be doing our best to address feedback and bugs as they come up. 

Thank you so much for spending time with our game, and we hope you enjoy it!
